Data sources & credits
Trail data © Sport Ireland · CC BY 4.0. The register is cached in this browser for up to 24 hours, with older cached routes available if the source cannot be reached.
Nearby activity locations © Get Ireland Active – Sport Ireland 2023 · CC BY 4.0
Heritage locations © National Monuments Service · Monuments to Visit · CC BY 4.0
Bus, rail and route labels © National Transport Authority · GTFS · CC BY 4.0. The map uses a feed snapshot valid 24 September 2026–24 September 2027; check current operator timetables before travelling.
Mobile site schedules © ComReg · 2026 Q1 non-confidential data. Site coordinates, licensed LTE/NR bands and maximum EIRP are derived into the published catalogue with source acknowledgement.
Terrain and paths © AWS Terrain Tiles (Terrarium elevation tiles).
Land cover © Copernicus Land Monitoring Service / EEA, CORINE Land Cover 2018. Radio-climatology © ITU-R P.1812-8 integral digital products.
Trail photographs are geotagged images from Wikimedia Commons. Each image links to its creator and individual licence.
Weather forecast © Open-Meteo · CC BY 4.0
Weather warnings © Met Éireann · Custom Open Data Licence (CC BY 4.0 equivalent). Warnings are matched to the route county, refreshed every minute, and expired alerts are removed. Met Éireann does not accept any liability whatsoever for any error or omission in the data, their availability, or for any loss or damage arising from their use.
Imported GPX files are read in your browser and are not uploaded or saved by the site. Route midpoint coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo for weather.
Terrain-derived profiles are estimates; listed ascent remains separate.
